uname -r
df -Pk /var/lib/ubicloud/pvm
df -Pk /
df -Pk /boot
curl --proto =https --proto-redir =https -fsSL --connect-timeout 10 --speed-limit 1024 --speed-time 60 --max-filesize 536870912 -o /var/lib/ubicloud/pvm/host-kernel.deb https://example.com/new.deb
dpkg-deb -f /var/lib/ubicloud/pvm/host-kernel.deb Package
env DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y --no-remove /var/lib/ubicloud/pvm/host-kernel.deb
apt-mark -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 hold linux-image-6.12.40-pvm
grub-editenv list
uname -r
findmnt -no FSTYPE /
update-grub
groupadd -f -r kvm
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable ubicloud-pvm-boot.service
grub-reboot ubicloud-pvm
grub-editenv list
grub-editenv list
